reviewItem.question: Does "The Kubernetes clients used by Cilium Agent and Cilium Operator now have separately configurable rate limits" mean a change to cli-flag:cilium|name=--operator-k8s-client-qps (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: The Cilium Operator's Kubernetes client rate limit is now configured separately from the agent's, and its default rose to 100 QPS/200 Burst (flags --operator-k8s-client-qps and --operator-k8s-client-burst).
